---
title: "Cell output, no language"
filters:
  - code-window
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
---

The div below has the shape an engine gives the output of an executed cell.
The filter leaves the block inside it as Quarto wrote it.

The block is indented rather than fenced, which gives the same code block with
no language, and reads as ordinary prose to a linter.

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

    [1] 1 4 9 16

:::
